title: "Repository layout"

Keep this map in sync with the package after any structural change (new or
moved modules).

```text
src/ai4copsec/restapi/
  __init__.py             # exports __version__
  version.py              # single version source (bumped by commitizen)
  config.py                # logging format constants
  app_settings.py          # AppSettings: env-file loading, OAuth/Keycloak config
  db_operations.py         # SQL helper(s) shared across db-backed endpoints
  v1.py                    # FastAPI app factory: lifespan, CORS, exception
                            #   handlers, mounts api/v1/router under /api/v1

  api/
    v1/
      router.py             # top-level router: mounts routes.py + each tb_*.py
      routes.py              # api_router, OAuth2 bearer scheme, TokenPayload
      response_models.py     # shared pydantic response models
      user.py                 # /user routes
      tb_common.py            # execute_or_http_error() - shared error translation
                                #   for all technological_brick/* routes
      tb_sod.py                # /technological_brick/sod/* (ship/oil detection)
      tb_dan.py                 # /technological_brick/dan/* (drift analysis)
      tb_shi.py                  # /technological_brick/shi/* (ship identification)
      tb_trp.py                   # /technological_brick/trp/* (trajectory prediction)
      tb_algorithms.py              # /technological_brick/algorithms (all bricks)

  cli/
    main.py                  # entry point (ai4copsec-restapi console script)
    base.py                   # BaseParser: subcommand-parser plumbing
    restapi.py                 # `start` subcommand (runs the API via uvicorn)

  db/
    v1/
      db.py                   # Database (re-exported from db_base)
      db_base.py                # SQLAlchemy engine/session setup
                                  # NOTE: imports a `.validation` module that does
                                  #   not currently exist in this repo - broken,
                                  #   pre-existing, not yet fixed.
      db_tables.py               # SQLAlchemy ORM table definitions

  timescaledb/
    dialect.py                # TimescaleDB-specific DDL/dialect glue
    functions.py                # custom SQL functions (e.g. `first`) for
                                  #   TimescaleDB queries

  utils/
    api.py                   # createFastAPI() app-factory helper
    cache.py                   # fastapi-cache key helpers
    command.py, docker.py, process.py, slurm.py, stats_types.py,
    system_info.py            # carried over from the slurm-monitor codebase this
                                #   package originated from; not yet audited for
                                #   relevance to ai4copsec-restapi specifically.

  resources/                # bundled data (e.g. sonar type specs), not code
```

Two naming inconsistencies are worth knowing about if you're navigating the
repo rather than trusting this map blindly:

- The test tree is `tests/aicopsec/` (no "4"), not `tests/ai4copsec/` as the
  package name would suggest - pre-existing, not yet renamed.
- Several modules under `utils/` and files like `db_operations.py` read as
  leftovers from an earlier, differently-scoped codebase (references to Slurm,
  clusters, nodes) rather than this package's own domain; they haven't been
  pruned or re-homed yet.
